claims.assertion: Churches and temples are described by Mari Swaruu as structures built over energetic sites and as potential portals to the lower astral.
claims.speaker: Swaruu de Erra (text read by Mari Swaruu)
claims.qualifiers: She presents this as her spiritual cosmology.

claims.assertion: Mari Swaruu warns that cemeteries may host lower-astral entities that can attach to living visitors, particularly children.
claims.speaker: Swaruu de Erra (text read by Mari Swaruu)
claims.qualifiers: This is her account, not established evidence.

claims.assertion: Mari Swaruu says advanced civilizations can detect astral entities using interferometers, gravity and mass shifts, and advanced optical lenses; she suspects human systems can too.
claims.speaker: Swaruu de Erra (text read by Mari Swaruu)
claims.qualifiers: The human-technology claim is explicitly her suspicion.

review_flags: The source presents spiritual and paranormal claims as fact; preserve attribution.
coverage_gaps: Other alleged dangerous locations and advice on alcohol, aura protection, and intuition omitted.
